name: British Columbia
summary_text: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): BC: consistently Canada's most progressive province on LGBT issues (first human-rights code inclusion 1992); Vancouver Davie Village scene. Regional evidence: no hostile provincial legislation, but a documented 2023 wave of coordinated disruptions against public drag-storytime events at libraries — Coquitlam Public Library postponed/cancelled repeatedly (Jan 14 2023 protest at the Town Centre branch; Oct 13 2023 postponement) under "public safety risk" claims, with a counter-gathering becoming the largest queer gathering the Tri-Cities had seen; at a Richmond library event with no police on scene a man pushed through to photograph the performer; a Granville Island children's drag camp was threatened and required a public rally of support. Scored relative to the national score (0.86) for Canada.

sources.title: The Daily — Police-reported hate crime in Canada, 2024
sources.claim_summary: Statistics Canada (March 2026): police-reported hate crime in 2024 (national): 4,882 incidents (+1% vs 2023 after a +34% jump 2022-2023); 658 incidents targeted sexual orientation (-2.6%); population rate 11.9 per 100,000. National climate context only - the release carries no provincial breakdown.
